title: Ziyuglycoside II, a triterpene glycoside compound in Sanguisorbae officinalis l. extract, suppresses metastasis in osteosarcoma via CBX4-mediated Wnt/beta-catenin signal pathway.
authors: Deng, Zhewen; Yuan, Jitong; Ma, Beiting; Zhu, Jie; Yan, Bingrong; Wei, Jingxun; Jin, Xin; Li, Jiaqi; Zhang, Qi; Ma, Bo
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药化合物ZGS II通过CBX4介导的Wnt/β-catenin通路抑制骨肉瘤转移，虽含分子对接但核心为肿瘤生物学与信号通路，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合机制研究。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Osteosarcoma (OS), the most prevalent primary bone malignancy, exhibits rapid growth and a high tendency for lung metastasis, posing significant treatment challenges. Ziyuglycoside II (ZGS II), a main active compound derived from Sanguisorba officinalis l., has shown potential in cancer treatment. However, the effects of ZGS II and its potential mechanism in OS remain elusive. PURPOSE: This study aims to explore the anti-metastatic potential of ZGS II in OS, offering a novel therapeutic strategy for improved patient outcomes. METHODS: Cell viability and proliferation was detected by cell counting kit-8 (CCK-8) and clone formation assay, respectively. Transwell and wound-healing assay were applied to evaluate the potential metastatic abilities of OS cells in vitro. More critically, the chromobox protein homolog 4 (CBX4) and Wnt/beta-catenin signaling pathway was investigated utilizing Western blotting, immunohistochemistry, shRNA knockdown and immunofluorescence. An orthotopic metastasis mouse model was utilized to evaluate the efficacy of ZGS II in suppressing OS metastasis in vivo, with molecular docking studies conducted to elucidate the interaction between ZGS II and the CBX4 protein. RESULTS: Our study demonstrated the potent inhibitory effects of ZGS II on OS cell proliferation and induced apoptosis in vitro, as evidenced by decreased cell viability, enhanced caspase-3 activation, and mitochondrial dysfunction. Furthermore, using an orthotopic metastasis mouse model, we illustrated that ZGS II effectively suppressed tumor growth and lung metastasis in vivo. Notably, our investigation revealed that the antitumor action of ZGS II is dependent on the reduction of CBX4 levels, leading to the attenuation of the Wnt/beta-catenin signaling pathway activation. Molecular docking analyses supported this pathway's suppression, showing that ZGS II has the capability to directly bind and disrupt CBX4 function. To further confirm this mechanism, we utilized shRNA to silence CBX4 in OS cells, which significantly enhanced the inhibitory impact of ZGS II on cell migration. CONCLUSION: Our study findings reveal that ZGS II efficiently suppresses both metastasis and tumor growth in OS by a novel mechanism that entails the inhibition of the CBX4-regulated Wnt/beta-catenin pathway. These outcomes highlight the promising potential of ZGS II as a therapeutic agent for managing metastatic OS, thus justifying the need for additional clinical investigations.
abstract_zh: 背景：骨肉瘤（Osteosarcoma, OS）是最常见的原发性骨恶性肿瘤，具有快速生长和高度肺转移倾向，给治疗带来重大挑战。地榆皂苷II（Ziyuglycoside II, ZGS II）是从地榆（Sanguisorba officinalis l.）中提取的主要活性化合物，在癌症治疗中显示出潜力。然而，ZGS II在骨肉瘤中的作用及其潜在机制仍不明确。目的：本研究旨在探讨ZGS II在骨肉瘤中的抗转移潜力，为改善患者预后提供新的治疗策略。方法：分别采用细胞计数试剂盒-8（CCK-8）和克隆形成实验检测细胞活力和增殖。利用Transwell和伤口愈合实验评估骨肉瘤细胞体外的潜在转移能力。更重要的是，通过Western blotting、免疫组织化学、shRNA敲低和免疫荧光技术研究了染色盒蛋白同源物4（CBX4）和Wnt/β-catenin信号通路。利用原位转移小鼠模型评估ZGS II在体内抑制骨肉瘤转移的功效，并进行分子对接研究以阐明ZGS II与CBX4蛋白之间的相互作用。结果：我们的研究表明，ZGS II在体外对骨肉瘤细胞增殖具有强效抑制作用并诱导凋亡，表现为细胞活力降低、caspase-3激活增强和线粒体功能障碍。此外，利用原位转移小鼠模型，我们证明ZGS II在体内有效抑制肿瘤生长和肺转移。值得注意的是，我们的研究揭示，ZGS II的抗肿瘤作用依赖于CBX4水平的降低，从而导致Wnt/β-catenin信号通路激活的减弱。分子对接分析支持该通路的抑制，显示ZGS II具有直接结合并破坏CBX4功能的能力。为进一步确认这一机制，我们利用shRNA沉默骨肉瘤细胞中的CBX4，显著增强了ZGS II对细胞迁移的抑制效果。结论：我们的研究结果表明，ZGS II通过一种涉及抑制CBX4调控的Wnt/β-catenin通路的新机制，有效抑制骨肉瘤的转移和肿瘤生长。这些结果凸显了ZGS II作为治疗转移性骨肉瘤的潜在药物前景，因此有必要进行进一步的临床研究。
